name: Skymount Fire Tower
summary: Steel guyed fire tower in Algonquin Park, torn down in the 1950s per firelookout.ca; a 2025 trail guide dates a Cache Lake tower to the 1970s.
design: Steel, guyed tower with an octagonal cupola
status_note: Torn down, according to firelookout.ca. No source describes what remains at the site.

access.note: Track and Tower Trail in Algonquin Provincial Park, open year-round. The guide ties part of the trail's name to the old Skymount site.

visit.trail_note: The trail runs roughly through the centre of Algonquin's Highway 60 corridor. No tower stands to climb.

events.note: Not shown on the Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map (1963), per firelookout.ca.
